Middle East Leaders Urge Iran Talks, Warn of Escalation

Leaders from Qatar, Turkey, and Jordan called for dialogue with Iran and increased international pressure on Israel. Concurrently, Israeli security officials issued warnings regarding a potential escalation of conflict across the Middle East. These discussions occurred in the context of the UN General Assembly, where topics such as the Iran war, Gaza, and Ukraine were also noted as points of attention.
